extracted.intended_audience: researchers and investigators seeking American Heart Association topic-focused research funding
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing research proposals targeted at American Heart Association topic-focused funding initiatives (e.g., rapid-response COVID grants, youth nicotine research, brain health initiatives) that must align with AHA priorities and program-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with AHA mission and strategic objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: The American Heart Association is committed to identifying and supporting specific science areas deemed critical to achieving our mission and strategic objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should address science areas identified by the AHA as critical and demonstrate how the work advances the AHA mission/strategic objectives. For more information about topic-focused research, contact the AHA (email provided on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: AHA/Allen Initiative in Brain Health and Cognitive Impairment — disruptive, frontier-opening research
rubrics_metrics.description: The AHA and Allen Frontiers Group ... have committed more than $43 million to disrupt the incremental trajectory of brain health science and open new frontiers of discovery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications to this initiative should propose transformative, non-incremental research in brain health and cognitive impairment that can open new frontiers. The program is positioned as an innovative partnership with substantial committed funding; applicants should emphasize disruptive potential and novelty.

rubrics_metrics.name: AHA COVID-19 Rapid Response Grant — innovative, highly impactful short-term proposals (9–12 months)
rubrics_metrics.description: Because of this issue's urgency, the focus was on innovative, highly impactful short-term proposals (9-12 months) that can show progress within the period of this award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target proposals that are both innovative and capable of delivering measurable progress within a short award period (9–12 months). Emphasize urgency, feasibility of rapid progress, and high potential impact on cardiovascular/cerebrovascular research related to COVID-19.

rubrics_metrics.name: End Nicotine Addiction in Children and Teens (ENACT) — bold, ground‑breaking youth-focused nicotine research
rubrics_metrics.description: The AHA committed $20 million to fund bold, ground-breaking research projects focused on the health impacts of nicotine and nicotine delivery products -- and to prevent and/or reverse the developing epidemic of nicotine addiction -- in children and youth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should be ambitious and comprehensive, directly addressing health impacts of nicotine delivery products in children and adolescents and include prevention or reversal strategies for nicotine addiction. Emphasize bold, ground‑breaking approaches given the program's intent and funding commitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mechanisms Underlying Cardiovascular Consequences of COVID-19 and Long COVID — mechanism-focused research and differential susceptibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The AHA committed up to $10 million to fund research on understanding the mechanism(s) underlying cardiac, vascular and cerebrovascular effects of COVID-19 and Long COVID, as well as mechanisms that contribute to differential susceptibility to Long COVID.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suitable proposals should focus on mechanistic studies explaining cardiovascular/cerebrovascular effects of COVID-19 and Long COVID, including investigations into why some individuals are more susceptible. Highlight mechanistic rigor and relevance to cardiovascular outcomes; note availability of program funding up to specified amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-specific scope, timeline, and funding considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Each topic-focused initiative specifies scope (research focus), expected timeline (e.g., short-term 9–12 months for rapid response), and committed funding amounts (examples: >$43M for AHA/Allen, $20M for ENACT, up to $10M for COVID-19 CV consequences).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must tailor proposals to the program's defined scope and expected timeline and be aware of the funding scale and priorities. Check program pages for lists of awardees and detailed requirements; contact the applications team for application logistics and clarifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact/applications process
rubrics_metrics.description: For more information about topic-focused research, please email (AHA contact) and there is an 'Email our applications team' link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided contact to obtain detailed application instructions, eligibility, deadlines, and any special submission procedures tied to the topic-focused initiatives.
